name: guaiacylglycerol-β-guaiac… to hydroquinone
summary: A 13-step route from guaiacylglycerol-β-guaiacyl ether to hydroquinone, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: methoxylated aromatic compound--corrinoid protein Co-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: guaiacol + Co(I)-[methoxylated-aromatic-compound-specific corrinoid protein] + H(+) = methyl-Co(III)-[methoxylated-aromatic-compound-specific corrinoid protein] + catechol

reactions.name: 5-methyltetrahydrosarcinapterin:corrinoid/iron-sulfur protein
reactions.equation: 5,6,7,8-tetrahydrosarcinapterin + methyl-Co(III)-[corrinoid Fe-S protein] = 5-methyltetrahydrosarcinapterin + Co(I)-[corrinoid Fe-S protein] + H(+)

reactions.name: [trimethylamine--corrinoid protein] Co-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: Co(I)-[trimethylamine-specific corrinoid protein] + trimethylamine + H(+) = methyl-Co(III)-[trimethylamine-specific corrinoid protein] + dimethylamine

reactions.name: dimethylamine monooxygenase
reactions.equation: dimethylamine + NADPH + O2 + H(+) = methylamine + formaldehyde + NADP(+) + H2O

reactions.name: methylamine dehydrogenase (amicyanin)
reactions.equation: 2 oxidized [amicyanin] + methylamine + H2O = 2 reduced [amicyanin] + formaldehyde + NH4(+) + 2 H(+)

reactions.name: 4-hydroxybenzoate 1-hydroxylase
reactions.equation: 4-hydroxybenzoate + NADH + O2 + 2 H(+) = hydroquinone + CO2 + NAD(+) + H2O

reactions.name: hydroquinone glucosyltransferase
reactions.equation: hydroquinone + UDP-alpha-D-glucose = hydroquinone O-beta-D-glucopyranoside + UDP + H(+)

reactions.name: lysine 6-dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: L-lysine + NADP(+) = L-1-piperideine-6-carboxylate + NH4(+) + NADPH + 2 H(+)

reactions.name: S-(2-aminoethyl)-L-cysteine + NAD(+) + H2O = S-(acetaldehyde)-L-cysteine + NH4(+) + NAD...
reactions.equation: S-(2-aminoethyl)-L-cysteine + NAD(+) + H2O = S-(acetaldehyde)-L-cysteine + NH4(+) + NADH + H(+)
